title: Coop net
summary: A co-op session on any net-link transport: seats and a handshake that refuses another protocol, build or world with a reason, numbered state packets with a 32-bit acknowledgement mask and packet fates, reliable records stamped with the tick, baselines of any size on a low-priority lane, RTT and per-peer tick estimates. The game owns the loop; peer bytes are untrusted.
provides: coop_session_lanes / coop_session_host / coop_session_join / coop_session_destroy: a session on a net_link
coop_session_seat / seats / tick_hz / seated / set_open / kick / set_world_key: seats and the handshake
coop_session_set_time / tick / end_tick / peer_tick: the game's clock, empty state packets that keep acknowledgements flowing, each peer's tick on both roles
coop_session_poll: WELCOME, SEAT_JOINED, SEAT_LEFT, CLOSED, STATE, RECORD, BASELINE with records_before
coop_session_send_state / send_record / send_baseline / baseline_progress / packet_fate / state_max / record_max
